name: Script-to-Shader SDF Preprocessor
definition: A C++ function that parses a custom script language to generate GLSL code for SDF scene composition, including loops, boolean operations, materials, and lights.
summary: The Script-to-Shader SDF Preprocessor is a C++ utility that compiles declarative scripts into GLSL fragment shaders, distinguishing itself by generating shader source code rather than volumetric data.
